JPMorgan Chase blocks external AI agents, says CEO

JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon said the bank is installing safeguards, described as “gates,” to protect against rogue AI agents and confirmed that the firm is not using external AI agents; the bank is blocking outside AI agents such as Muse and Instinct from directly accessing customer accounts.
